full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2079
Sixth Session
Meeting Number - 49
Federal
Daily Business Schedule
Friday, Bhadra 13, 2082
1:00 PM
Table of Message
1. Harka Raj Rai, Secretary of the House of Representatives, will table the bill along with the message received from the National Assembly concerning the "Nepal Citizenship (Second Amendment) Bill, 2082".
2. Reshuffle in Joint Committee
Honorable Speaker will reshuffle the names of honorable members in the Parliamentary Hearing Committee within the Joint Committee.
Management Work
Honorable Balram Adhikari, Minister for Land Management, Cooperatives, and Poverty Alleviation will:
(a) Present a proposal to discuss the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws Related to Land, 2082".
(b) Present a proposal to pass the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws Related to Land, 2082".
Padma Prasad Pandey
General Secretary

sections.name: Table of Message
sections.summary_en: The Secretary of the House of Representatives, Harka Raj Rai, will table a message from the National Assembly regarding the Nepal Citizenship (Second Amendment) Bill, 2082. This marks the formal introduction of the bill with amendments from the upper house.

sections.name: Reshuffle in Joint Committee
sections.summary_en: The Honorable Speaker will make changes to the membership of the Parliamentary Hearing Committee, which is part of the Joint Committee. This section deals with internal administrative adjustments within parliamentary committees.

sections.name: Management Work
sections.summary_en: Minister Balram Adhikari will present proposals for discussion and passage of the Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws Related to Land, 2082. This section focuses on legislative business concerning land laws.
